params.name: View direction arrow
params.tooltip: Show an arrow in the minimap's camera box that points where the camera is looking.

params.name: Debug: performance log
params.tooltip: Off: normal play. On: every 30 s, Better Minimap writes how long its map builds, camera box updates and window renders took to the game's log file (stdout.txt, lines starting with [SQPERF]). Only for tracking down slowdowns; leave it Off otherwise. Slow calls are always logged briefly, whatever this setting.
